about_the_game:
Experience the most epic campaign of ancient Rome. Join Julius Caesar's troops, cross the Alps and reduce the resistance of the Gauls. Establish dominion over the rebellious tribes alongside one of the greatest politicians and military men in History.

The new free content for Citadelum, The Gallic War, includes new and more challenging missions, in which to explore the new mechanics recently introduced in the game update, such as performing levies in other cities to swell the ranks of your army.

The Gallic War also introduces a new biome, the autumn forest, which adds more variety to the game, a new type of enemy: the fearsome Gallic tribes, and the possibility of establishing diplomatic relations with nearby populations or building wonders in our cities.

Accompany Julius Caesar and lend him your help before he crosses the Rubicon and seizes power in Rome, while the conspirators try to stop his advance. The time has come to make history.
